description: Full-time, remote. Focused on automating the company's manual processes end to end — built a Claude Code automation that cut JSM ticket turnaround from two weeks to eight hours and lifted a significant load off the team. Currently migrating workloads from on-premises datacenters to GCP.

Joined while the platform was building brand-new AWS infrastructure after the acquisition. Worked across its full lifecycle — from designing IP subnets for every environment class to operating it against production-grade standards.
Migrated the platform from hand-managed VM servers with git-pull deployments to a properly engineered GKE infrastructure.
First two years at the company — then operating under its previous name — building PHP applications, mostly in Laravel.
First commercial contracts before graduating school: simple websites, a Unity game, a Xamarin mobile app, an Electron desktop app, and several larger Laravel CMS projects.
